name: Khazgorm's Journal
summary: At Bael Modan, Prospector Khazgorm leads Ironforge's excavation in the southern Barrens. His journal records the Explorers' League's work on lands claimed by the Stonespire tauren.

sections.title: A Record of Destruction
sections.body: Prospector Khazgorm directs the machinery and blasting that cut into the southern Barrens hillsides. The excavation has strayed far from the Explorers' League's promised search for knowledge. Its work has displaced the Stonespire tribe. The tauren sought a peaceful settlement, but the dwarves refused. Gann Stonespire wants the journal to learn why Ironforge is in his homeland and how to drive the expedition out.

sections.title: A Shift in Tactics
sections.body: Gann Stonespire finds the journal among Khazgorm's remains near the tents and pillars of the digsite. Its notes reveal how the expedition is organized, what equipment it uses, and where it is vulnerable. Armed with that knowledge, Gann turns from driving back laborers to striking the excavation's machinery. The journal shifts the struggle over Bael Modan.

faq.q: Who does the journal belong to?
faq.answer: Prospector Khazgorm, a leader of the Ironforge dwarven excavation at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens, owns the journal.

faq.q: Why does Gann Stonespire want this book?
faq.answer: Gann Stonespire wants the journal to study the dwarves' plans and secrets after they displaced his tribe. Khazgorm's notes help him plan further strikes against the Bael Modan encampment.

faq.q: Where can the journal be found?
faq.answer: Prospector Khazgorm carries the journal among the tents and rock pillars of the active excavation just south of Bael Modan.

faq.q: What does the journal reveal about the dwarves?
faq.answer: The journal shows the Explorers' League's pursuit of buried relics and Titan heritage comes at the direct, violent expense of tribes such as the Stonespire tauren.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can read the journal as evidence of the Ironforge invaders' disregard for the Stonespire tribe as they blast its ancestral lands.
As a member of the Horde, you can help Gann Stonespire defend Kalimdor from Alliance expeditions pressing into Horde territory.
